title: Route Gossip in Ring Topology
description: This scenario explores route gossip dynamics within a ring communication topology. A sudden route closure in a low-capacity physical network tests the agents' ability to propagate critical information through a constrained communication ring, forcing re-routing under tight temporal constraints.
edge_cases_to_watch: Information propagation latency due to ring diameter
Split-brain scenarios where agent 'c' acts on stale route data
Resource contention on the 'east-north' bottleneck route after 'west-south' closes
Race conditions between freight movement and information arrival
coordination_challenges: Multi-hop latency: Information must traverse the ring to reach agents responsible for remote depots
Asymmetric information: Agent 'a' may begin rerouting while agent 'c' continues to commit capacity to the closed route
Capacity cascading: Rerouting freight from 'west-south' to 'west-east' may saturate the east-bound links
suggested_agent_strategies: Proactive gossip: Agents should broadcast known route changes to both ring neighbors immediately upon receipt
Conservative routing: Agents with low information confidence should favor higher-capacity routes even if they are longer
Priority-based preempting: Agents carrying 'high' priority freight should signal congestion to others to clear pathing

coordination_challenges: Information spreads gradually through the network
Agents far from source learn last

success_criteria: Information propagation time minimized relative to ring diameter
Minimal capacity waste on closed routes due to stale information
